csv_scope_of_work: The Tennessee Department of Transportation (TDOT) seeks to retain the services of professional engineering consulting firms to provide expertise in transportation project management, transportation engineering, program implementation, and program support services. Scope of Services: Shall include, but may not be limited to, the items of work described below: A. Project Development (including concept, risk, cost, and schedule) Support B. Planning and Environmental Management C. Project Management Support D. Right of Way, Utility, & Railroad Support E. Local Programs Support F. Professional Surveying and Mapping G. Geotechnical Support H. Structures & Hydraulics Support I. Maintenance Engineering and Operations Support J. Construction Management (including schedule review) Support K. Asset Management Support L. Program Management (including schedule review) Support M. Professional Engineering Services Contractual Support N. Communications O. Project Design and Design Review (including Structures) Services P. Alternative Delivery Contract Services Q. Traffic Design and Operations (including ITS) Services R. Independent Cost Estimating (ICE) Services (including detailed production-based, contractor-style independent cost estimates) S. Design Review & Risk Workshop Support T. Project Planning (including Interstate Access Request), Revenue, and Environmental Services U. FHWA Major Projects Support V. Roadway Technology Support W. Life Cycle Planning
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Traffic Design Engineering

title: Engineering Services - Project Management Division
short_description: TDOT seeks multidisciplinary transportation engineering and project management consulting support services.
project_scope: Statewide/on-call transportation program support for TDOT covering project development, planning and environmental management, project and program management, right-of-way/utility/railroad support, local programs, surveying and mapping, geotechnical services, structures and hydraulics support, maintenance engineering, construction management, asset management, engineering contractual support, communications, project design and design review including structures, alternative delivery support, traffic design and ITS, independent cost estimating, risk workshops, interstate access request/revenue/environmental services, FHWA major projects support, roadway technology, and life cycle planning.
services: Professional engineering consulting services for transportation project management, transportation engineering, structural engineering support, design and design review including structures, surveying, geotechnical, hydraulics, traffic, environmental, construction management, and program support; contract duration 60 months; up to 3 contracts may be awarded.
relevance_explanation:
- Broad multidisciplinary transportation/program management framework rather than a defined bridge or special structure project.
- Includes structures and design review support, but only as one part of a very wide on-call scope.
- Strong focus on project/program management, environmental, ROW, utilities, and support services, which are not core sbp targets.
- No specific structurally ambitious bridge, roof, stadium, or special structure identified.
- Multiple awards and framework-like character reduce strategic relevance for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. This is a professional services procurement for on-call/project management and engineering support over a 60-month period, not a defined construction project. No realistic project-specific construction cost can be derived from the notice.
fee_explanation: No fee or estimated contract value is stated in the notice. Up to 3 contracts may be awarded over 60 months, but the document provides no pricing basis for a reliable fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Professional engineering consulting firms with expertise in transportation project management, transportation engineering, program implementation, and program support services. Disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, cost estimating, environmental engineering/planning/design, structural engineering, utility engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, and traffic design engineering.
contracting_authority: Tennessee Department of Transportation (TDOT), Nashville, Tennessee, USA. Contact: Chasity B. Evans. Phone: 615-253-3997. Email: tdot.psadvertisements@tn.gov. Website: https://www.tn.gov/tdot/business-redirect/consultantinfo/currentads.html
notes: Project #: 869758; ProjectID: 1015870; DR #: 202600270427. Target market: Streets/Highways. Pre-submittal meeting: 2026-07-13 01:00 PM CDT at Region 3 Auditorium, 6601 Centennial Boulevard, Nashville, TN 37243; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 2026-07-29 04:00 PM CDT. Solicitation documents available online. Contract duration: 60 months. Up to 3 contracts may be awarded. Although structural engineering is included, this appears to be a broad transportation engineering support/framework-style procurement rather than a specific bridge or building project.
